name: Ember Vow — Pink Pepper Amber Gourmand
claim: A literature-bounded, exact product-mass design and conditional stock realization; no sensory, clone, liking, safety or release superiority.

locked_brief.text: Accessible pink-pepper aromatic gourmand: clear pepper and lavender over a roasted-nut/toffee illusion, vanilla, soft suede and warm transparent woods. An original competitor in the Stronger With You Intensely territory, not a clone.
negative_space: huge amberwood or extra musk stack
locked_brief.temporal_goal: Opening identity -> coherent heart -> subordinate supportive drydown; not a measured trajectory

chassis.mobile_sockets: Trace modifiers, texture support and competing musk/amber alternatives only within this brief
chassis.omission_plan: Compare LEAD with ROAST_OMISSION first. If the roast becomes corn chips/pandan, omit/reduce pyrazine before buying more nut materials. If syrupy/powdery, compare DRIER_CONSERVATIVE. Preserve pepper/lavender clarity before increasing woody power.

decision_changes: Replace the old mixed stock-volume target with 100% undiluted-product mass. Piperonal is now 24 mg solid per 6 g target, never a neat uL row.
Give pepper and lavender explicit compositional priority; mandarin, juniper and cardamom bridge them instead of adding a second opening theme.
Make vanilla/Tonkarome/coumarin/benzoin the body of the roast illusion, with pyrazine and ethyl maltol only as small modifiers.
Keep Alpha Irone as a deliberately narrow powder bridge. The old reason that AIMI identity was unresolved is obsolete: the owned PW AIMI is now resolved, but is not chosen for this target.
Keep Romandolide as the one selected musk. Do not add Ambrox merely because a warmer gourmand is being redesigned.

candidates.hypothesis: Full pepper/aromatic/roast/suede network; development lead, not a sensory winner.
Less sweet/powdery; test whether warmth survives.
Does pyrazine earn its role rather than add savory drift?
More spice/suede tension; may reduce immediate gourmand ease.
Independent simpler chassis; complexity must earn a perceived benefit.
No authenticated quantitative reference, original prompt recovery or sensory calibration is available; official notes cannot supply a literal formula.

pareto.selection_reason: Qualitative design coverage and practical stock accounting, not demonstrated sensory superiority

accounting.concentration_definition: 20% by undiluted perfumery-product-equivalent mass, not 20% identified odorant or stock volume

finished_options.ethanol: q.s. measured final 30.00 mL after dissolution and equilibration

accounting.ethanol_96_percent_as_supplied: Count as solvent product mass; strength basis not silently converted to absolute-ethanol mass

small_sample.extra_alcohol_rule: If a grams of dissolution ethanol enters the master, aliquot (stock_total+a)/6 and add 5-(stock_total+a)/6 grams ethanol; never count a twice.

stock_notes: The recorded Vanillin 10% v/v nominal, Ethyl Maltol 1% v/v and pyrazine 1% DPG of unstated basis are NOT the exact w/w stocks required below. Use a verified mass-fraction stock or prepare it from the neat product; do not assume those stocks were already prepared. The current Tonkarome 20% w/w TEC, coumarin 10% w/w DPG, Siam benzoin 50% w/w DPG and Alpha Irone 10% w/w DEP can be weighed as shown.
stock_preparations: Vanillin 10% w/w ethanol: 0.50 g neat Vanillin + 4.50 g perfumery ethanol. Neat PW 1VW00456 is a sourcing option, not an owned-stock assertion.
Ethyl Maltol 1% w/w ethanol: 0.10 g neat product + 9.90 g ethanol. PW 1VF00175 is a sourcing option; the old v/v stock is not an equivalent.

2-Acetyl Pyrazine 0.1% w/w DPG: make or verify a 1% w/w intermediate, then mix 1.00 g intermediate + 9.00 g DPG. A 1% intermediate can be made with 0.10 g neat PW 1EN13109 + 9.90 g DPG. Do not serially dilute the old stock until its basis is known.
Suederal 1% w/w ethanol: 0.10 g owned neat Suederal + 9.90 g ethanol. Piperonal is weighed directly at 24 mg in this batch.
mixing_order: Weigh the wood/musk/solvent scaffold, then Hedione and the known balsamic/coumarin stocks.
Add Alpha Irone and vanilla stock. Dissolve the separate 24 mg Piperonal charge using part of the final alcohol allowance and keep that alcohol in the mass ledger.
Add Isobutavan and the three trace working stocks; then lavender, clary sage, geranium and linalyl acetate.
Add mandarin, pepper, juniper and cardamom last. Close, mix and inspect after equilibration.
